subject: Fix ordering of neighbors in CME (#631)
reason: The fix changes behaviour only inside SearchPartitionResultsTracker in src/query/fanout.cc, which is constructed solely by PerformSearchFanoutAsync, and that fanout runs only when UsingCoordinator() && IsCluster() (src/commands/commands.cc:139-167). UsingCoordinator() requires the hidden 'use-coordinator' config: it is registered with .Hidden() (src/valkey_search_options.cc:144), hidden configs are never registered with the server (vmsdk/src/module_config.cc:110-112), so it cannot be set via CONFIG SET or server_config, only as the '--use-coordinator' module load argument.
